name: part-forge
description: Designing, verifying, and printing functional parts: a measured-facts ledger that governs the model, parametric generators, an acceptance gate that reads the exported bytes back off disk, and slicer tuning grounded in real stock values.

plugins.name: part-forge
plugins.description: Design functional 3D-printable parts as parametric generators with measured inputs and a gated verification harness. Turns a physical problem into a facts ledger, a Blender generator script, an acceptance gate that refuses to export a bad solid, and a headless audit of the exported bytes.

plugins.name: print-tune-bambu
plugins.description: Recommend Bambu Studio print settings grounded in the local install's real stock values, a mirror of the official wiki, and a headless slice. Emits an importable process preset and a brief where every change is traced to a named failure mode.
